12.t: Working with data: newton meter readings
q: On which floor was the biggest force needed?
How much more force was needed on carpet than on tiles?
Describe the pattern and suggest which force causes it.
Rougher floors needed more force: from 0.6 N on tiles to 3.8 N on the grass mat; the force is friction, which is bigger on rough surfaces.
Suggest two control variables and explain why the mean of three trials was used.
Same car (mass), same newton meter, pull horizontally, same starting position. Three trials reduce the effect of one odd reading, so the mean is more reliable.
